beats.text: Ice is closing over the water near your home. Open water and safe footing will be harder to find.
Summer arrives. Heat dries pools and plants; know where water lasts.
Autumn arrives. Leaner months are coming: store food or learn richer ground.
A group of 4 mirelicks has moved into the ground near your home.
Ice is closing over the water near your home. Open water and safe footing will be harder to find.
New life: 2 young rillsifters were born near your home.
Spring arrives. Growth returns; young born now have the best start.
